items.reason: This is an explicitly configured, deployment-wide integration with a trusted parent application (.env.example:233-244), so its authority to select users is intentional. The handler requires the configured webhook secret and decryptable credentials before writing (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:24-28,57-59,73-78); requiring possession of privileged integration secrets does not establish an authorization bypass.

The command at .env.example:243 encodes 24 random bytes into 32 ASCII characters. packages/lib/crypto.ts:33-37 consumes that string as Latin-1 bytes, without Base64 decoding, giving the required 32-byte AES key; the proposed command would instead produce an invalid 44-byte key.
